Rashi on Menachot 110a:11:1.english: What is [the meaning of] that which is written: "This is the Torah" - And it is not written regarding it "a statute".

Rashi on Menachot 110a:12:1.hebrew: עולה ומנחה מיבעי ליה - דליהוי משמע: זאת התורה היא עולה ומנחה, כו':
Rashi on Menachot 110a:12:1.english: It should have [stated]: "A burnt offering and a meal offering" - So that it would mean: "This Torah is a burnt offering and a meal offering," etc.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:12:2.hebrew: אין צריך לא עולה וכו' - דהכי משמע: זאת התורה לעולה, כלומר במקום העולה; למנחה, בשביל המנחה, כגון לכם, בשבילכם. כלומר, התלמוד תורה מכפר על עונותינו:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:12:2.english: Need not [bring] a burnt offering, etc. - For this is what [the verse] means: "This is the Torah for a burnt offering" — that is to say, in place of the burnt offering; "for a meal offering" — for the sake of the meal offering, as in [the word] lakhem, [which means] "for you." That is to say, Torah study atones for our sins.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:13:1.hebrew: בתורת חטאת - כגון סדר קדשים, דמיירי בהלכות עבודה:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:13:1.english: In the law of the sin-offering - For example, the Order of Kodashim, which deals with the laws of the [Temple] service.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:15:1.hebrew: שנת העובד - עבודת קרבנות ומביאו למזבח, מתוקה שנתו, שהוא ישן ולא ירא:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:15:1.english: The sleep of the laborer - [This refers to one who performs the] service of sacrifices and brings it to the altar. "His sleep is sweet" — [meaning] that he sleeps and is not afraid.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:15:2.english: Whether he eats little or much - [This refers to] the bestowal of his reward.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:16:1.english: When goods increase - [This refers to] sacrifices.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:16:2.english: Those who eat it increase - [The] priests.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:16:3.hebrew: ומה כשרון לבעליו - להקדוש ברוך הוא, כי אם ראות עיניו, שזה מתכוין לטובה:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:16:3.english: And what advantage is there to its owner - [Meaning,] to the Holy One, Blessed be He. "Except the sight of His eyes" - that this [person] intends [it] for good.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:17:1.hebrew: לבעל הדין - לאומרים רשויות הרבה הן, והדבר מוכיח שזה ששמו כך ציום להקריב לו מנחה, [וזה] ששמו כך ציום להקריב לו פרים, וזה אילים. לכך נאמר בכולם ריח ניחוח לה':
Rashi on Menachot 110a:17:1.english: To the disputant - To those who say [that] there are many authorities, and [that] the matter proves [it]: that this one whose name is such commanded them to sacrifice a meal-offering to him, [and this one] whose name is such commanded them to sacrifice bulls to him, and this [one] rams. Therefore, it is stated regarding all of them: "A pleasing aroma to the Lord."

Rashi on Menachot 110a:20:1.hebrew: כדי שתאמר אעשה רצונו - להקריב לו קרבן, ויעשה רצוני, לפי שהוא צריך לכך ואשחדנו:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:20:1.english: So that you say, "I will do His will" - To offer Him a sacrifice, and He will do my will, because He needs it and I will bribe Him.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:20:2.hebrew: לא לרצוני אתם זובחים - כלומר, לא להנאותי, שאיני רוצה להטריח אתכם לעשות על כרחכם:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:20:2.english: Not for My will do you sacrifice - That is to say, not for My pleasure, as I do not wish to burden you to act against your will.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:20:3.hebrew: לרצונכם - לצורך עצמכם, לקיים מצוותי, שתהא כפרה לכם בכך:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:20:3.english: For your will - For your own need, to fulfill My commandments, so that there will be atonement for you through this.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:21:1.hebrew: לרצונכם זבוחו - שתהא כוונתכם לשחוט, פרט למתעסק בסכין לחתוך דבר אחר ושחט בהמת קדשים, שפסולה:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:21:1.english: Slaughter of your own will - That your intention must be to slaughter, to exclude one who was handling a knife to cut something else and slaughtered a sacrificial animal, which is invalid.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:22:1.hebrew: מנין למתעסק - בדבר אחר ושחט בהמת קדשים, שהוא פסול:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:22:1.english: From where [is it derived regarding] one who acts unawares - [One who was occupied] with something else and slaughtered a consecrated animal, that it is disqualified.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:23:1.english: This is in our hands - That it is a mitzvah to focus one's mind.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:23:2.english: You shall slaughter it of your own will - Scripture repeated it to make it indispensable.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:4:1.hebrew: מכירין את ישראל - בכבודן הראשון מכירין, ואין מכבידין עולם:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:4:1.english: They recognize Israel - They recognize [them] in their former glory, and do not make their yoke heavy [upon them].

Rashi on Menachot 110a:4:2.hebrew: ואת אביהם שבשמים - שמאמצים בהקדוש ברוך הוא, ואין מאמצים בעבודת כוכבים:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:4:2.english: And their Father in Heaven - That they strengthen themselves in the Holy One, Blessed be He, and do not strengthen themselves in idol worship.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:5:1.hebrew: שימי את - בתמיה: אתה הוא שימי, חכם גדול, ומקשה לי דבר זה? ויש אומרים: רב לא היה זוקף עיניו, אלא כובשן כל שעה משום צניעות:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:5:1.english: Are you Shimi? - [Spoken] in astonishment: Are you [really] Shimi, a great scholar, and [yet] you raise this difficulty against me? And some say: Rav would not raise his eyes, but rather kept them lowered at all times out of modesty.

Rashi on Menachot 110a:7:1.english: This is one who studies Torah in purity - Concerning him [the verse] says: "To My name, and a pure meal offering."

Rashi on Menachot 110a:9:1.hebrew: לעולם זאת על ישראל - מקרא הוא בדברי הימים (ב סי' ב), בשלמים ובקרבנות משתעי דלעולם הם עומדים. והיכי דמי? מזבח בנוי בשמים, ומיכאל עומד ומקטיר עליו:
Rashi on Menachot 110a:9:1.english: This is an ordinance forever for Israel - It is a verse in Chronicles (II, chapter 2); it speaks of peace offerings and sacrifices, [stating] that they endure forever. And how can this be? An altar is built in Heaven, and Michael stands and burns [offerings] upon it.

Tosafot on Menachot 110a:7:1.hebrew: הלומד תורה בטהרה נושא אשה ואחר כך לומד תורה - בפרק קמא דקידושין (דף כט:) איכא למאן דאמר איפכא, ואמרינן: לא פליגי, הא לן והא להו:
Tosafot on Menachot 110a:7:1.english: One who studies Torah in purity: he marries a wife and afterwards studies Torah - In the first chapter of Kiddushin (29b), there is an authority who says the opposite, and we say: They do not disagree; this is for us [in Babylonia] and that is for them [in the Land of Israel].

Tosafot on Menachot 110a:9:1.hebrew: ומיכאל שר הגדול עומד ומקריב עליו קרבן - מדרשות חלוקין: יש מי שאומר נשמותיהן של צדיקים, ויש מי שאומר כבשים של אש. והיינו דאמרינן בשמונה עשרה בעבודה: "ואשי ישראל ותפלתם מהרה באהבה תקבל ברצון". ויש אומרים דקאי אדלעיל: "והשב את העבודה לדביר ביתך ואשי ישראל". לא מצאתי יותר:
Tosafot on Menachot 110a:9:1.english: And Michael, the great prince, stands and offers an offering upon it - Midrashim differ [as to what he offers]: there is one who says [it is] the souls of the righteous, and there is one who says [it is] sheep of fire. And this is what we say in the Shemoneh Esreh in [the blessing of] the Temple service (Avodah): "and the fire-offerings of Israel (ishei Yisrael) and their prayer, swiftly accept with love and favor." And some say that it refers to what comes before: "And restore the service to the inner sanctuary (devir) of Your House, and the fire-offerings of Israel [as well]." [The copyist notes:] I did not find any more.
